name: TASK_RETRY_AND_HISTORICAL_STRUCTURE_V1
local_retry: predecessor Task remains immutable and must not already have a direct retry successor
allocate a new opaque Task identity; never reuse predecessor task_id and never clone accepted execution/outcome/review evidence
new Local Task name defaults to predecessor current descriptive name but is a reviewed input and obeys bounds
new Task requires its own accepted positive-duration plan before scheduled grouping; retry_clone origin records predecessor plan provenance but the new interval is independently reviewed
SR/RFC/Device Reference relationships are cloned only from explicitly selected current predecessor relationships shown in preview; closed/history-only relationships are not silently reopened

Inventory-owned reservation/spare-use relationships are never copied directly by LLD-05; selected eligible Inventory relationships cross the future LLD-07 preview/apply participant and any missing/indeterminate authority fails closed
append exactly one immutable immediate task_retry_relations edge predecessor->successor; predecessor unique and successor unique prevent forks/merges in direct retry chain
new retry enters ordinary global grouping after commit; Objective predecessor/successor context is query-derived through Task retry edges and may therefore be many-to-many across Objectives
wfm_retry: a retry WFM must already possess a distinct canonical TK+14 identity; no command derives or increments provider Task No.
exact same TK is the same WFM attempt and cannot become its own retry
LinkWfmRetryAttempt revalidates both identities, exact requested Task revisions, immediate-edge uniqueness and no cycle before appending the immutable retry relation
LinkWfmRetryAttempt preserves all activity-lineage events/current projections; retry-edge creation and reviewed activity classification are separate authorities

after the retry edge exists, ReviewWfmActivityRelationship may explicitly accept retry_lineage using that exact immutable edge as fingerprinted evidence, or may classify the attempts as distinct_activity or unresolved_source_error when the reviewed evidence supports that decision
provider source facts/status/plans of both attempts remain independent
the successor enters normal plan reconciliation and grouping; no Objective is cloned or linked directly as a retry target
retry_cycle_guard: direct schema uniqueness prevents more than one immediate predecessor/successor

before insert walk predecessor chain from proposed predecessor and successor chain from proposed successor using indexed point lookups until null; encountering the other target rejects TASK_RETRY_CYCLE
guard is bounded by number of Task attempts and does not hold unbounded rows in memory
activity_lineage_review: lineage is a reviewed SOMA operational classification, never inferred solely from same RFC, Task Name, Summary or overlapping time
distinct_activity leaves/assigns separate lineage context so multiple distinct WFMs may coexist in one Objective
same_activity assigns one shared lineage and triggers active-overlap conflict evaluation
retry_lineage requires a legal pre-existing retry edge and shared lineage; the review never creates, redirects or deletes that retry edge
unresolved_source_error preserves all identities and blocks automatic competing-attempt resolution
lineage correction appends events and preserves prior classifications
historical_proposal_creation: trigger only from an accepted LLD-04 WFM source projection whose provider_lifecycle_class=complete, with a complete valid accepted source plan and no current Objective membership
Plan Cancel is historical source evidence but is not eligible for historical Objective creation
provider Complete/source plan do not create Task execution/outcome/Device/Inventory facts
capture exact source projection revision, accepted source observation id and source plan start/end in historical_objective_proposals
if task_plan_current is absent, expected_matching_operational_plan_revision_id=null and the proposal may later establish a dedicated historical_source_structure plan upon acceptance
if task_plan_current exactly equals source interval, capture that revision as expected matching plan
if a current operational plan exists and differs materially, do not create an immediately acceptable historical structure; expose normal source-vs-operational-plan reconciliation first
proposal fingerprint additionally binds Task identity/revision, current membership absence, execution/outcome absence, plan current revision/absence and current Objective overlap set
historical_acceptance: inside current UnitOfWork revalidate exact provider Complete source projection revision/observation/source plan, Task unassigned state, no accepted execution/outcome and exact proposal fingerprint

if no current operational plan exists, insert the one outer receipt then append task_plan_revision origin=historical_source_structure using exact accepted source interval/timezone provenance and set task_plan_current

if current operational plan exists, it must exactly match the captured source interval and expected matching revision; any difference returns HISTORICAL_PROPOSAL_STALE/NOT_ELIGIBLE and requires separate plan review
use the resulting exact plan revision as Objective membership pin
prove interval strictly overlaps no current nonsuperseded Objective; historical acceptance never restructures existing current Objectives

allocate new stable MW tracking identity, create Objective creation_origin=historical_provider_complete, append historical_add membership, rebuild envelope and aggregate execution_state=historical_structure
leave actual_start_utc/actual_end_utc null and task_outcome_current absent
audit only source/plan/structure references and commit atomically
historical_rejection_and_refresh: rejection preserves WFM/source evidence and leaves Task unassigned
later source-plan correction, source projection revision, accepted plan reconciliation, execution evidence or Objective membership materially stales/supersedes the old proposal
a fresh eligible state may create a new proposal; old proposal/disposition remains immutable
operational_count_exclusion: only Task history classified as historical/provider-backfill is eligible for exclusion from current operational counts
append inclusion event; default absent row means included
Objective included_task_count/excluded_task_count is derived from current members

when every member of a historical Objective is excluded, aggregate_outcome=excluded_from_operational_counts while execution_state remains historical_structure or reviewed historical presentation as defined by reporting owner
reports/filters must disclose included and excluded populations separately
hard_delete_classification: Task is immediately BLOCKED when source-adopted/provenance-bearing, has any accepted execution/outcome/retry/activity-lineage correction, historical Objective participation, closed protected relationship, archive/review/cascade consequence or other protected operational evidence
manual WFM/Local Task with only current draft-like plan/current relationships may proceed only if all local dependencies are exactly previewed and LLD-07 returns CLEAR
INDETERMINATE from any dependency provider fails closed
Objective hard deletion is limited to untouched manual creation with no protected operation/review/archive/regroup/supersession history; automatic/historical Objectives are blocked
hard deletion never reuses MW tracking sequence, Task identity or provider Task No. and never deletes audit_events
